confirmedRules.duplicateBuilds: Preserve multiple builds when their requirements differ. For matching requirements at the same stage and multiplier, retain only the cheapest build. Do not assume unstated requirements match.
confirmedRules.lightChoices: L means Light. Each L permits buying one additional ship, choosing its type, or buying none.
confirmedRules.omittedLightRequirements: If L requirements are not mentioned, no Light purchases are required. Do not mark them unknown solely because they are omitted.
confirmedRules.sharedTrailingLightRequirement: A trailing L requirement applies to all multipliers in the caption only when the flow is uninterrupted: there are no additional parenthesis groups, no changes between bold and non-bold text, and the L note is the very last text. Otherwise keep the L note local to its variant. Confirmed specifically for B3B E6: both 1.2x cost 17.5 and 1.4x cost 11.25 require L1 Corvette. Check the original rich text formatting before applying this rule.
confirmedRules.parenthesizedDecimals: Parenthesized decimal digits record the fractional cost that the game truncates for its integer display.
confirmedRules.baseMeaning: A base is a boss present in some stages.
confirmedRules.baseKillMeaning: This build is intended to kill the base. Some bases take multiple shots (tries), and the kill shot may use a different build.
confirmedRules.unstatedBaseFields: When a caption does not specify Base shots, leave the field unspecified. When it does not specify Base kill, use false. Explicit one-shot kills and previously confirmed kill builds retain their stated shot count and true kill status. Confirmed using BB1 A2 (1.6x, cost 110, damage 375.44) as the example.
confirmedRules.noBaseMeaning: No base means a new run of the stage after the base has already been killed, not clearing remaining ships from the same battle. Encode base false and baseKill false.
confirmedRules.slashSeparatedMultipliers: Separate exact multiplier values, not continuous ranges.
confirmedRules.missingCost: Omit all entries that have no listed cost at all. Preserve grouped exact multipliers that share an explicitly listed cost. Previously confirmed cost overrides remain valid.
confirmedRules.clarifications: Review unresolved entries one at a time with the user. Do not hide ambiguous data in Comments.
